cpu_active_only.semantics: 1 Hz interval statistics, not instantaneous peaks or repeat confidence intervals. Intervals outside 0.5–2.5 s are excluded from peaks/near-95% durations. 95% is a descriptive warning threshold, not proof of CPU saturation. Process CPU sums all threads; tick-thread CPU was not collected separately. Per-core CPU includes all processes on that core; the tick thread may migrate. Executing CPU excludes idle/iowait/steal; steal is reported separately.
